description: What a website is and what it runs on, from one request: name, description, language, share image, social profiles, contact emails and phones, feeds, and the technologies detected (CMS, framework, analytics, payments, hosting, CDN). Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Site checks: Fast checks on any site without a browser: HTTP headers with a security grade and the redirect chain, TLS certificate and expiry, DNS records with mail setup (SPF, DMARC), what a site is built with and its contacts, robots.txt and AI crawler access, and a crawl that finds broken links and builds a sitemap..
name: net_tools_site_info
